arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Meade argued Congress created two distinct rules. He asked the Court to reconcile them. He noted all aliens may file one motion.
Mr. Kneedler stated a motion does not suspend departure. He emphasized the Board's order sets a fixed time. He argued the obligation remains active during the appeal.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The case tests how two immigration rules interact. One rule sets a short exit window. The other allows a one-time appeal. The Court must define their relationship.
